creative_direction.name: Midnight Ballroom Two-Column
creative_direction.brief: A photographic night interior: a deep ink-blue painted hall meets a continuous dark lacquered parquet ground at a low horizon, one soft pool of ambient light breathing on the floor behind the subject's true base line where the measured contact shadow lands on toe and heel tips. The cutout holds the right column while the left column carries a wrapped narrow-sans monument: brand at column head, the name across two tall wrapped lines, a short pale rule closing the column - vertical overlap with the shoulder but wide horizontal clearance keeps the editorial grid honest. Matte night paint against vermilion lacquer reads as quiet theatre after hours.
creative_direction.material: ink-blue painted hall wall with continuous dark lacquered parquet ground
creative_direction.lighting: soft diffuse nocturnal ambient with one gentle pool of light on the ground, no hard shadows, matching upper-front-left key
